faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Field Investigator post at Ram Lal Anand College is 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed M.Tech in Computer Science/Cyber Security/IT or equivalent, or M.Sc in Computer Science/Digital Forensics/Cyber Security or equivalent.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of INR 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Ram Lal Anand College Field Investigator recruitment?
faq.answer: You can apply online by filling out the Google form provided, along with your detailed CV and scanned copies of certificates, before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Field Investigator post at Ram Lal Anand College.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled to be conducted on 08 August 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is experience required for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Working knowledge in programming is required, and research experience in digital forensics is desirable.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
